description: Westbury Plaza is a prominent power center strategically located at 1220-1250 Old Country Road in Westbury, New York, positioned next to the Gallery at Westbury Plaza and just half a mile from the renowned Roosevelt Field Mall. Spanning 390,215 square feet, this outdoor shopping destination has established itself as a cornerstone of Long Island's retail landscape, offering an impressive lineup of nationally recognized anchor tenants including Costco, Walmart, Marshalls, Total Wine and More, and Olive Garden. The center's strategic location in one of Nassau County's most affluent communities provides shoppers with convenient access to value-oriented big-box retailers and popular dining options, all complemented by ample parking facilities. With over 10.5 million annual visits, Westbury Plaza serves a thriving trade area characterized by high household incomes exceeding $173,000 and substantial home values, making it a preferred shopping destination for Long Island's discerning suburban families. Managed by Regency Centers, the property benefits from professional oversight and strategic tenant curation that ensures a dynamic mix of retail, dining, and service offerings that meet the evolving needs of the local community.
